title: Insiders Just Bought $48 MILLION of ONE Stock… No One Is Selling
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: Large, rare, record-size insider buys with a good track record are a strong signal to follow.

calls.reason: CEO Ryan Cohen and three directors bought $48M (his largest ever); collectibles +57% y/y, record Q2 operating income; ~$7.5B net balance-sheet assets vs ~$12B cap = ~7x free cash flow.
calls.quote: GameStop trades around 24. Last May, it hit 35. If it gets back there, it's about 50% above the current price

notes: 'Three weeks ago, on September 10th' implies ~Oct 1, matching listing. Target 35 is the prior May high he frames as the upside, not a firm price target; 'buy' is implied by his insider-buying framework rather than said outright.
